title: Annotated Code of Maryland, Labor and Employment Article, Title 3, Subtitle 5 - Wage Payment and Collection
verified_how: Fetched the section page for Article - Labor and Employment, § 3-501: the page serves the live text, opening '(a) In this subtitle the following words have the meanings indicated', and defining 'employer' as including 'any person who employs an individual in the State or a successor of the person' and 'wage' as 'all compensation that is due to an employee for employment', including bonuses, commissions, fringe benefits, overtime wages and 'any other remuneration promised for service'. Served from the register with enactments=false, i.e. the text currently in force; mgaleg prints no as-at date (recorded in access_notes).
notes: Pair with Title 3, Subtitle 4 (Wage and Hour Law, Md. Code, Lab. & Empl. §§ 3-401 to 3-431), which sets the State minimum wage and overtime; Subtitle 5 governs how and when wages must be paid and the treble-damages collection action.
